tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search the PostLaunchKit directory of human-reviewed free tools and projects, including AI agent tooling. Returns published entries only.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one published directory entry by its slug.

tools.name: run_launch_check
tools.description: Run the PostLaunchKit launch check on a public website. Returns how many checks passed (passed, total), each check with status pass or fail and a fix for failures, and a report link. 20 checks per IP per day. Public sites only.

tools.name: list_launch_directories
tools.description: List directories and listing sites where an indie product can be submitted, from the open launch-directories dataset (CC BY 4.0). Each row has submit_url, free_or_paid, requires_account, link_type, review_time, submit_steps and notes. Blank means not verified. Run run_launch_check on the product sit

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List directory categories with the number of published entries in each.

tools.name: submit_project
tools.description: Suggest a product for the directory. The submission is saved as pending and reviewed by a person; nothing is published automatically.
